info.title: Magica Agent API
info.description: Talk to the Magica agent, run its media tools and follow runs. All amounts are microcredits.

apiKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer ak_…` (API keys, from the app's user menu).

default.description: Error envelope; `code` is one of the closed set (see Errors).

post.description: Creates the chat with its first message and starts the agent's reply (a run).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same UUID again to get the same message and run back instead of a second one.

201.description: The chat, its messages and the run answering.

default.description: Error envelope; `code` is one of the closed set (see Errors).

get.description: The chat with its newest messages (newest first) and its active run, if any. Pass `cursor` for older messages.

default.description: Error envelope; `code` is one of the closed set (see Errors).

post.description: A follow-up in the chat. 409 `RUN_ACTIVE` while a reply is still running.

201.description: The new message and the run answering it.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible. The last `user` message is the turn; pass `chat_id` to continue a chat. With `stream: true` the answer arrives as server-sent `chat.completion.chunk` events ending in `[DONE]`; tool steps ride in `magica`. Without it the call waits up to 60s, then answers 202 with the run to poll.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same UUID again to get the same message and run back instead of a second one.

200.description: The answer (`stream: false`), or an SSE stream of chunks (`stream: true`).

202.description: Still running (a long generation or an approval): poll the run.

default.description: Error envelope; `code` is one of the closed set (see Errors).

post.description: Runs `crop_image`, `gpt_image_2` or `merge_videos` directly, with the same validation, credits and approvals as in chat. The input is the tool's own (see Running tools). Answers 202: poll the run or use webhooks.
